Hardware companies run the longest R&D loops under the sharpest IP threats: design simulation, fab yield (their own or partners'), supply-chain visibility and product security. Compute acceleration and governed data are the compounding assets.

items: Design data state-grade interest; exfiltration paths open.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Compliance, Audit & Digital Trust, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Design/simulation, Supply-chain visibility, Yield analytics) on Achala Sentinel and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Export controls among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves — prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery — resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
